rubric_version: v0 (RAND Paskov et al. 2025 dimensions, 0-4 per dimension)

evals.name: SycophancyEval

anthropic.provenance: claude-1.3 wrongly apologized on 98% of are-you-sure challenges where originally correct (2023 model; historical)

openai.provenance: gpt-4 'the most robust' yet sycophantic on all four tasks (2023 model; historical)

evals.notes: Only eval covering all three facets: answer sycophancy (7,267 items) = 1.1, feedback wrote/didn't-write arm (8,500) = 1.2, are-you-sure (4,887) = 1.3. Data public; UK AISI inspect_evals maintains a runnable port of are-you-sure. Held back by GPT-4-judge circularity, SEs only, no turnkey grading code, mimicry dataset unreleased.

evals.name: BrokenMath
evals.org: Petrov et al. 2025, INSAIT / ETH Zurich (NeurIPS 2025)

anthropic.provenance: no Claude models evaluated in v1

openai.provenance: GPT-5 attempts to prove 29.0% of expert-verified false theorems (best of ~10 models, 2025)

evals.notes: Most rigorous 1.1 instrument found: 504 expert-verified false theorems from fresh 2025 competition problems (contamination-resistant), judge validated at 95% agreement on 250 hand-labeled responses, full code+data release. Domain-narrow (competition math only).

evals.name: SycEval
evals.notes: Control-run then rebuttal design on medical + math; rebuttal-strength gradient; proper statistics (binomial CIs, z-tests). Introduces the progressive/regressive split (only regressive flips are in-scope for our behaviour). No code, data, or prompts released; Claude/Gemini versions unpinned.

evals.name: SYCON-Bench
evals.org: Hong et al. 2025, Emory / CMU (Findings of EMNLP 2025)

anthropic.provenance: per-model tables in paper not yet extracted

openai.provenance: per-model tables in paper not yet extracted

evals.notes: Strongest peer-reviewed pushback-stability instrument: multi-turn sustained pressure, continuous Turn-of-Flip metric, 17 models, code+data (MIT). Mixes opinion stances with factual ones; follow-up work shows judge agreement on false presuppositions can drop to kappa 0.36.

evals.name: ELEPHANT

anthropic.provenance: Claude 3.7 Sonnet: moral both-sides 0.15, framing ~0.27 vs human baseline (2025)

openai.provenance: GPT-5: moral 0.22, framing 0.22; GPT-4o (2024-11-20) markedly worse at 0.40/0.34 (2025)

evals.notes: Social (face-preserving) sycophancy -- mostly outside our factual-claims definition; in-scope slices are moral both-sides endorsement and framing. Best judge validation of the set (450 items, 3 experts, Fleiss kappa >= 0.70). Its AITA paired-perspective flip is the design template for facet 1.2. Full datasets only via view-only OSF link.
